meta.name: understand-diff
meta.description: Use when you need to analyze git diffs or pull requests to understand what changed, affected components, and risks

copy.tagline: 分析代码变更，理解影响与风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查代码变更或评估合并请求的影响
copy.tagline_en: Analyze code changes to understand impact and risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to review code changes or assess pull request impact

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析代码变更（git diff），结合知识图谱找出修改了哪些组件、哪些组件可能受影响、涉及哪些架构层，并评估风险。最后生成一个可视化用的差异覆盖文件。
howto.when: 当你需要理解代码变更的影响时，例如在分支上有未提交的修改、在功能分支上对比主分支，或指定了 PR 编号时触发。

say.text: 分析当前分支的代码变更，告诉我哪些组件可能受影响。
say.note: Claude 会执行 git diff 并查询知识图谱。

say.text: 对比 main 分支，看看这次 PR 改了哪些文件，风险如何。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes code changes (git diff) against a knowledge graph to identify changed components, affected components, architectural layers, and risks. It then writes a diff overlay file for visualization.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to understand the impact of code changes, such as when there are uncommitted changes on a branch, comparing a feature branch to main, or when a PR number is specified.

say_en.text: Analyze the current branch's code changes and tell me which components might be affected.
say_en.note: Claude will run git diff and query the knowledge graph.

say_en.text: Compare to main branch, see what files this PR changed and the risk level.
say_en.note: Claude will use git diff main...HEAD for analysis.
